location: Capitol Extension E005 for public comment & online 200 West 24th Street
title: The purpose of this meeting is to receive the 2026 K-12 education resource block grant model (funding model) monitoring report pursuant to W.S. 21-13-309(u), including the annual update of the regional cost adjustment in accordance with W.S. 21-13-309.1(f). The meeting will be held remotely, with a live video stream available on the Legislature's Website (www.wyoleg.gov). A limited number of participants can sign up to provide public comment virtually for a specified agenda item during the Committee's upcoming meeting.
